title: Moreish Puff Sherbet Lemon Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: E-liquids don’t get more nostalgic, or delicious, than this classic Lemon Sherbet flavour, which carries the deliciously sweet-sharp taste of hard lemon candy with the enervating tickle of sweet fizzy sherbet. Moreish Puff’s Nic Salt e-liquid’s nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief and smooth throat hit provided by nic salts.
